title: T-033 retrieval evaluation harness
summary: The deterministic harness ran the fixed 25-question set against the lexical baseline and left later retrieval variants stubbed.
evidence: The lexical baseline ran all 25 questions with no zero-result question.
The metric table records result count, top source, refusal alignment, and latency per question.
Refusal alignment was correct on 20 of 25 questions.
The independent rerun reported 65.04 ms mean retrieval latency and 104.63 ms P95.
FTS5, vector, and fusion slots remain explicitly stubbed.
Only report artifacts were added, the database checksum remained unchanged, and the worktree has no remote.
limitations: This establishes the lexical baseline, not a production cutover threshold or final answer-quality score.
